deliverable: Six class model sheets, 20 labeled poses each
common:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Deliverable: ONE complete class action / expression MODEL SHEET for MAAT RPG, a coherent illustrated set comparable to the robot action sheet reference. This is a labeled class pose board, not an isolated single character.
Reference image 1 is the APPROVED class character design: preserve its exact face, hair silhouette, proportions, clothing, headgear, class accessories, palette, gold outlines, and simple charming flat geometric cartoon style throughout EVERY pose. Reference image 2 is the existing robot action sheet: use ONLY for the concept of clearly separated labeled poses with colorful effects. Do NOT turn the class into a robot unless reference 1 itself is the robot.
Create a high-resolution portrait board, 2048 x 2560 or larger matching 4:5 proportions. Title at top in pale gold. Below it, EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS of equally sized panels, exactly 20 full-body figures. Uniform dark navy background #071024, panels slightly lighter navy #101d37 separated by generous gutters. Clean simple pale-gold sans-serif labels centered beneath each figure. No text on the characters, no HP numbers, no interface controls. Same character scale and baseline within each panel, including effects with comfortable margins, no cropped feet, wings, hats or staff.
Visual style: simple flat teal-blue #254c65 shapes, clean even pale gold #dec787 outline, gold diamond #e8c576, pale cyan details, warm tan simple human face when applicable. Never add realism, dimensional shading, textures, ornate clothing, complex anatomy or painterly rendering. Preserve the friendly approved design. Slight rotations, expressive eyes, arms and legs make each pose noticeably DIFFERENT, still the SAME character.
Order is strict left to right, top to bottom. The exact panel labels and pose contents:

Keep all 20 labels exactly once and in that order. Do not omit panels, replace panels with text, merge panels or repeat the same pose without the required action. No other captions or subtitles.
